title: Sprite Library: Pixel Font Pairs Vol. 1 joins, 55 packs now
html:
Pixel Font Pairs Vol. 1 is now in the Sprite Library: six original pixel fonts in three genre pairs, each pair a dialogue face and a display face drawn together. The Library now holds 55 packs, worth $395.45 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: the fonts are in vfx-icons-and-fonts/font-vol-cozy-scifi-sea-pixel-font-pairs/.

{{IMG:shot_6_inside_vfx_icons_fonts.png}}

  • Kettle & Clover: cozy farm and life sims (Kettle 13 px dialogue, Clover 24 px display).
  • Signal & Static: sci-fi terminals and title cards (Signal 13 px dialogue, Static 24 px display).
  • Brine & Chart: seafaring logbooks and sea charts (Brine 14 px dialogue, Chart 24 px display).
  • 197 characters in every face: printable ASCII, the typographic marks and Latin-1.
  • Each face ships as a BMFont .fnt with its PNG page and as a TrueType .ttf. In a blank Godot 4.7.2 project both drew all 28 test lines pixel for pixel, with no grey edge pixels.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. Every glyph was drawn as code by an AI agent; no image model was used.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
